item.title: 🌐 From Dreamer to Digital Creator: How SitesGPT Empowers Non-Techies to Build Stunning Websites.
item.description: ✨ Meet Layla: The Dreamer Who Thought She Couldn’t Build a Website Layla always had a vision. A small online shop selling handmade jewelry inspired by Turkish poetry and Mediterranean colors. But every time she tried to build a website, she hit a wall—HTML, CSS, hosting plans, plugins… it was overwhelming. She wasn’t a developer. She wasn’t a designer. She was a creator with a dream. Then she discovered SitesGPT—an AI-powered website builder that changed everything.
